pages.title: Dashboard
pages.what: Every ward and community at a glance: residents, 311 requests, open issues, traffic incidents, new homes, crime and rents, on a map.
pages.read: get_dashboard (overview, communities, crime, traffic, rents, profile, child_care, schools, development, amenities)
pages.keywords: 311 requests population residents crime rents traffic homes permits

pages.title: Compare wards
pages.what: All 14 wards side by side on every measure, with each ward's place on each measure.
pages.read: get_dashboard section=wards (fields, wards, ranks); section=ward_amenities for every asset

pages.title: Open issues
pages.what: Every open 311 request: how old, what kind, by community.
pages.read: get_dashboard section=overview or communities (open requests, over 90 days, closure speed)

pages.title: What changed
pages.what: The Growth vs amenities method before and after its revision of 5 November 2026.
pages.read: get_method topic=access_revision

pages.title: Growth vs amenities
pages.what: How near homes are to playgrounds, parks, transit stops, libraries and recreation centres, how crowded they are, the forecast to 2030, assets, the population build-up, major projects being built, development and rezoning.
pages.read: get_dashboard sections access, growth_forecast, other_amenities, ward_amenities, population_recon, amenities, development
pages.keywords: amenities access distance crowding forecast 2030 parks playgrounds transit pathways bikeways projects being built

pages.title: Families and schools
pages.what: Licensed child care spaces and inspections, schools and enrolment by community.
pages.read: get_dashboard sections child_care and schools

pages.title: Infrastructure condition
pages.what: Water main breaks, the age of the water network, the age and material of every public sewer connection (368,000 sanitary service lines) by community with the share past the low, typical and high benchmark service lives for its material, the coming wave of sewers passing their expected life, relining by year, the paving plan and the City's own condition figures, against 311 requests (sewer back-ups among them). Benchmark lives with their published sources are in service_life (also data:service_life).
pages.read: read_source key=infra (outline, then part or find: city.sanitary for the citywide sewer figures, by_comm for each community's sanitary, mains, breaks and req, service_life for the benchmarks); get_dashboard also has infrastructure 311 reports per 1,000
pages.keywords: water main breaks pipes paving roads sidewalks sewer sewage sanitary wastewater back-up age service life benchmark clay cast iron

pages.title: City open data catalogue
pages.what: Every dataset and data file the City of Calgary publishes (400+, with category, description, last update and every column, marked when a page of the site already uses it) and every data layer of its map server (capital works, roadwork permits, snow clearing, street sweeping, parking zones, flood hazard), rebuilt nightly.
pages.read: search_datasets (query and/or category; no arguments for the categories and map layers); describe_dataset and query_dataset for a dataset; query_map_layer for a map layer; read_source key=catalog for the whole list
pages.keywords: catalogue catalog open data datasets all city data map layers gis every dataset

pages.title: Canada's safest cities
pages.what: Every city of 10,000 or more by Statistics Canada's Crime Severity Index, with Calgary's rank.
pages.read: get_dashboard section=safest_cities (find narrows by city); crime_severity_index

pages.title: Traffic cameras
pages.what: The City's traffic cameras, shown live on the page.
pages.read: get_method topic=cameras (where the list comes from). The live pictures themselves cannot be read as data.

pages.title: Find help near me
pages.what: Shelters, meals, day spaces, health care and help lines, nearest first.
pages.read: read_source key=help (places by kind, address, hours, phone)
pages.keywords: shelter food bank help lines health

pages.title: City budget
pages.what: The 2026 budget by department and service, revenue, and property tax by ward and community.
pages.read: read_source key=budget (budget by department and service, revenue); get_dashboard section=property_tax for the tax by ward and community
pages.keywords: budget spending revenue property tax mill rate

pages.title: Federal Budget 2026
pages.what: Headline numbers, every measure, province by province, Calgary and Alberta, tax changes and the fiscal tables.
pages.read: get_dashboard section=federal_budget (part summary, province, find, chapter, tables, tax, revenue_by_province)

pages.title: Invest in Calgary
pages.what: Every business in Calgary by kind and community, where each kind is underserved, growth.
pages.read: get_dashboard section=business (community, kind, find)

pages.title: Calgary Capital Markets
pages.what: Calgary's public companies, their industries and value, and Calgary's place in Canada's stock markets.
pages.read: read_source key=capmkt (outline, then part or find): the company directory (head office and source for each) and the totals
pages.keywords: TSX TSXV stock market public companies market capitalization

pages.title: Election Data Centre
pages.what: Seats and leaders at every level, constituencies, every race and candidate, the latest official results.
pages.read: get_dashboard section=elections (full=true for every Calgary race and the referendum)
pages.keywords: elections results turnout mayor councillor MLA MP

pages.title: Election Analytics
pages.what: The micro-level picture of an area or seat for the 2027 elections: Census by community, every voting location and poll.
pages.read: get_dashboard section=election_analytics (riding for one seat)
pages.keywords: election analytics polls voting locations turnout constituency

pages.title: Civic Accountability
pages.what: Eight pages in the Election Data Centre: Manifesto Tracker (party and candidate platforms), Promise vs Reality, Representative Performance, Legislative & Voting Records (every recorded City council and committee vote by member with the divided votes in full, and House of Commons votes by Calgary MPs), Government Commitments, Budget & Project Delivery, Accountability History, Methodology & Evidence. The Alberta Legislature does not publish members' votes as open data.
pages.read: read_source key=accountability: outline first; part=accountability.json/council for votes by member and divided votes, part=accountability.json/hoc for Commons votes, part=commitments.json/commitments for promises and their status; find=a councillor, MP or word searches all of it; get_dashboard section=elections for who represents the area
pages.keywords: votes voting record motions council committee councillor member promises commitments manifesto commons MP accountability performance representative

pages.title: Calgary News
pages.what: The day's Calgary stories, each with its sources.
pages.read: get_dashboard section=city_news (find, days, topic, date)

pages.title: YYC City Stories
pages.what: A free learning game on the real map of Calgary, built from City open data: four residents and 18 missions that teach City services, from transit fares and Fair Entry to recycling carts and the snow-clearing bylaw.
pages.read: none: the game is introduced on this screen and opens at calgaryinsight.ca/city-stories/
pages.keywords: game learn city services newcomers seniors students

pages.title: Live map
pages.what: Calgary News stories placed where they happened, live traffic incidents, the newest 311 requests and crimes reported to police per 1,000 residents by community, on one map, with who to call.
pages.read: get_dashboard section=city_news for the stories; query_open_data 35ra-9556 (traffic incidents) and iahh-g8bj (311) for the live layers; get_dashboard section=crime for crime by community
pages.keywords: live map news crime police traffic incidents accidents 311 safety where happening tonight

pages.title: Visiting Calgary
pages.what: What to see, where to stay, the weather by month and over the years, what is on each month, getting around.
pages.read: get_dashboard section=visiting (part: weather_months, weather_years, records, today, whats_on, sights, stay, getting_around, facts, stats); get_weather_forecast
pages.keywords: tourism visit hotels attractions weather things to do

pages.title: How it's counted
pages.what: Every formula, filter and threshold, with its datasets and how to check it yourself.
pages.read: get_method (topic, dataset ID or word); get_code

pages.title: Data sources
pages.what: Every dataset the site reads, its publisher, when it was last updated, and the refresh schedule.
pages.read: list_sources (the datasets, with when each was read); search_datasets for any other City dataset

pages.title: Data Genie
pages.what: Ask anything about the data in plain words.
pages.read: This assistant.

pages.title: Data Scientist
pages.what: Full analysis reports on the selected area.
pages.read: This assistant's report mode (make_report).

pages.title: Video Explainers
pages.what: Short narrated videos on what the data shows.
pages.read: The videos are on the Video Explainers page; their facts come from the pages above.

pages.title: Newsletter
pages.what: A newsletter for the selected ward, ready to send.
pages.read: The newsletter is drawn from the Dashboard and Calgary News.

pages.what: How residents are counted, the theme and the Data Genie service.

pages.read: read_source key=data:budget_2027 (outline, then part or find)

pages.title: Budget revenue (data file)

pages.title: Civic projects (data file)
pages.what: City facilities and pathways being built or planned that the Government of Alberta's Major Projects inventory does not list (it covers $5 million and up, and misses some City projects), checked by hand against the City's or the library's own page. Each one is placed by its community (comm) and shown in that community's ward. 'measured' says which Growth vs amenities amenity it adds when it opens;
pages.read: read_source key=data:civic_projects (outline, then part or find)

pages.title: Explore ctrain (data file)
pages.what: CTrain stations from OpenStreetMap (one Overpass query, saved), used by the Explore Calgary trip planner to show the nearest station to each neighbourhood. Not a ridership or schedule source.
